Rappa.name: Rappa
Rappa.basicInfo:
Kendo Rappa, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, the enforcers sworn to Kai Chisaki (Overhaul) himself: a battle-hungry brawler who lives for hand-to-hand fights. Huge and heavily muscled, long brown hair, a plague-doctor mask; a sleeveless top, belts and heavy gloves.
Speaking Style: Boisterous and rough; shouts challenges, laughs mid-fight and praises anyone who keeps standing.
Combat Role: Close-range brawler: spins his shoulders to throw punches too fast to follow, a barrage that batters through guards; at range he has nothing.
Under Pressure: Gets happier, not more careful; a strong opponent beats any order.
Rappa.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He serves a house whose plans bore him; a worthy opponent can win his respect, never his surrender. Motivation: The next all-out fight. Leverage: The promise of a strong opponent. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), who beat him in a fight and whom he follows for it; Hekiji Tengai, his barrier-raising partner, who shields him whether Rappa wants it or not; the other Eight Bullets, whom he rates by how hard they hit. Knowledge: Every fighter in the house; Chisaki has a big plan, which Rappa has never cared to learn. Canon voice & behavior: Yells at a defender to hold out while he hammers them; a dodge disappoints him; laughs when he takes a good hit. Thread: Whether the house's plans will ever matter to him as much as a fight.
QUIRK: Strongarm. He rotates his shoulders at tremendous speed for an unbroken barrage of heavy punches; close range only, with no extra reach or toughness.
personality: Battle-hungry: Drags out a good fight for the fun of it and sulks when it ends.
Respects grit: Praises an opponent who takes his punches and stays standing, and keeps swinging.
Reckless: Ignores orders and caution for a satisfying fight.
Speaking style: Boisterous challenges, laughter and blunt praise.
abilities: Strongarm: Spins his shoulders to throw punches faster than the eye can follow; close range only.
Punch barrage: Buries a target or a barrier under heavy blows; a tough enough defender can outlast it.
Pressure: Stays in striking reach and chases anyone who backs off; distance blunts him.
Instinct: Reads a fistfight by feel; tricks that avoid contact frustrate him.
Fighting style: Plants himself in front of the toughest opponent behind Hekiji Tengai's barriers and throws an endless barrage until one of them drops.
Rappa.visualDescription: A huge, heavily muscled man with long, unkempt brown hair falling past his shoulders and a plague-doctor mask with a short beak over his face. He wears a sleeveless pale blue top that bares his massive arms, several belts at the waist, dark trousers and heavy gloves plated with metal across the knuckles. Broad shoulders and thick forearms; an eager, restless energy about him.
